name: Bijou's Reconnaissance Report
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Take this report back to Lexlort. It will redeem my good name and will surely give the K.E.F. a strategic advantage in dealing with these orcs.

Come with you? I've got way too much work to do. Get going, they need these reports as soon as possible!
narrative.objectives: Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I've got to hand it to her; she's managed to weasel her way out of another sticky situation! These reports will prove to be invaluable in our dealings with the Blackrock orcs.

Of course, you will be rewarded for your hard work.
